name: Dialog hand-over data class
membershipRule: A Class, Structure or enumeration declared in a form's file or beside it that holds only fixed fields or named values and exists to carry a dialog's choices or a form's own rows, such as FilterConfiguration passed to the main window or the form-private PolValueInfo. Classes that hold values read from policy definition files, such as AdmxProduct, belong to the policy data class kind.

name: Policy state script routine
membershipRule: A method of SpolFile or SpolPolicyState that parses policy-state script text (SPOL) into policy states, writes a state back as script text, or applies the states to a policy source. Methods of other policy classes belong to the policy logic routine kind.

name: Policy data class
membershipRule: A plain class, structure or enumeration, or the field part of a class, that only holds values read from policy definition files or built from them (AdmxProduct, AdmxProductType), with no screen controls. Dialog hand-over shapes belong to the dialog hand-over data class kind. Its methods are separate blocks of the policy data routine kind.
